The `history` folder is `packages/engine/src/live-docs/history/`, next to `pathfind.ts`. I found 45 files in it by searching the explorer. The search shows only 12 results at a time, so I searched by first letter to get past that cap.

- `bundled.ts` and `bundled.test.ts`
- `codec.ts`
- `derive.ts` and `derive.test.ts`
- `directories.ts` and `directories.test.ts`
- `format.ts`
- `git.ts` and `git.test.ts`
- `lens.ts` and `lens.test.ts`
- `queries.ts` and `queries.test.ts`
- `rows.ts` and `rows.test.ts`
- `sampling.ts` and `sampling.test.ts`
- `sequence.ts` and `sequence.test.ts`
- `shape.ts`
- `summary.ts` and `summary.test.ts`
- `textStore.ts` and `textStore.test.ts`
- `ticks.ts` and `ticks.test.ts`
- `versionControl.ts`
- `window.ts` and `window.test.ts`
- `words.ts` and `words.test.ts`

I checked every starting letter from `b` through `w`, except `h` and `i`. The unfiltered list ran in alphabetical order from `bundled` to `lens` with no gaps, so nothing starting with `h` or `i` appears to have been skipped. I didn't search for `x`, `y` or `z`, and no `a`-prefixed file turned up. The search only lists files the explorer has indexed, so I didn't see the folder on disk, and a file it doesn't index wouldn't appear.

I didn't copy anything to the clipboard.
